plugin.description: Follow a named nearby player using terrain navigation and foreground WASD input.
hint: Select WASD movement in PoE2. F8 starts/stops; Escape stops. Foreground game only. Start in preview mode and inspect the route.
choose_leader: Select the leader from nearby players
no_players: No nearby players detected. Move into the same area as the leader.
limits: Follows a named visible player in the same area. Closed doors need manual opening. No portals or background dual-client input. Losing the target, focus or area stops following; press F8 to resume.
status.stopped: Stopped — F8 to start, Escape to stop
status.area_changed: Area changed — press F8 to resume
status.settings_open: Settings open — close settings, then press F8
status.frame_gap: Rendering paused or delayed — press F8 to resume
status.unfocused: Game lost focus — press F8 to resume
status.game_state: Not in active gameplay — press F8 to resume
status.panel: Chat or panel open — close it, then press F8
status.player_invalid: Player unavailable or dead — press F8 when ready
status.leader_name: Select the leader from the nearby-player list first
status.target_missing: Leader unavailable, dead, or outside visible range — press F8 to retry
status.target_changed: Target identity changed — press F8 to resume
status.terrain_missing: Terrain/position unavailable or target too far away
status.no_path: No walkable route — check doors and wall clearance
status.manual: Manual movement detected — press F8 to resume
status.stuck: No movement progress — stopped; press F8 to retry
status.following: Following — F8 or Escape to stop
